verdict.rationale: The documented endpoint paths include an explicit version segment (/marketing/v3/emails), so the API is versioned. Nothing in the pack describes a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version lifecycle, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, version lifecycle or changelog documentation, independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
